introHtml: Green sticky notes and flags are a natural choice for highlighting key information, designating approvals, or categorizing files by department. Whether you are a safety manager marking compliance checkpoints or a marketing director color-coding campaign timelines, green stands out without overwhelming. These printed notes and flags take custom logos or text cleanly via offset or digital print, making them a practical giveaway for trade shows, office supply orders, or internal training kits.
